title: Five People, Ten Hobbies
shared_passage:
Listen to five people talking about their hobbies. For each person, choose the TWO hobbies they mention.

HANNA: I like to go to the mountains with my friend Becky. She loves to walk, but I can't do that because of my bad knees. So, while she goes hiking, I paint. I did some lovely pictures of a lake last month. They are on Becky's wall now. I also love to watch films. I watch one every day. Yesterday, I saw one about some friends who started a band. They played their music around the world and became really famous. It was great!

KATE: I spend most of my free time playing Island Life. It's a computer game where you are on an island, and your mission is to survive. You need to grow plants for food and collect wood in the forest so that you can cook and build a home. But when bad weather or dangerous animals appear, you can die, and then you have to start again. It's really cool! I also like to collect coins. I have lots of old coins. Some of them are rare. I'm always looking for more coins in shops and on the Internet.

WILL: My friend Mike is the singer in a band, and last year he asked me to join them because I play drums. So, I did it, and now we play together. It's fun! We do a few shows every week, and we are sometimes on the radio. Last week we played at a festival in a beautiful garden with lots of pretty flowers. It was great! My friends in the band love partying and they often go out after a show, but I prefer to go to bed with a good book. I read two or three every week.

SIMON: Well, my friend Charlie grows vegetables in his garden. I'd like to do that too, but I live in a flat and don't have a garden. But I love going for long walks in the countryside. I go for miles and miles, and I often come home with something like mushrooms, nuts or fruit. Then Charlie and I put everything in the kitchen, and I cook dinner with it. I love preparing food in new ways. Maybe one day, I will invite some friends for a party and will cook for them.

PATTY: My neighbour plays in a band, and she practices her guitar every evening really loudly. So I can't have a quiet evening at home watching a film. So I often go out. My friends are always having parties, and I go too. I meet new people, and they invite me to more parties! It's fun, and it's also a good way to collect more cups. I have about 200 now. I like funny ones and ugly ones. It's fun to see the different cups in people's kitchens. You can learn about people from their cups, and sometimes they give me one to take home.
